m8Formula:
Dormant Rate (%) = Dormant Customers ÷ All Customers × 100%

Dormant = customer's last transaction was more than N months
before the reference date ("as of")
m8FormulaNote: N (dormant month threshold) varies by business type, auto-resolved from the dominant division in the selected scope (Settings → Threshold).
emptyTable: No dormant customers for this scope/period
